fingerprints.runtime: SHA-256 over certificate, request/round, prefix/history, target/draft summaries, route/cache/hidden state, support, score, threshold, q_t, B_t; the certificate separately binds q_min/q_max, the causal cost model, and reset policy

order: observe causal context and finish optional feature acquisition
fail to exact before any coin if certificate, support, delay, or prospective pathwise gate is invalid
freeze a terminal fast proposal, score, threshold, support, B_t, predictable cost forecast, q_t, and both fingerprints
append the frozen decision tuple before revealing the coin
draw audit uniform from the independent audit broker
audit runs fast in rollback shadow, runs exact, commits exact
nonaudit commits fast and receives no imputed label

rng.controller_access: epoch secret and audit uniform hidden until decision freeze
rng.replay: precommit key hash and key id; disclose key after epoch closure
rng.theorem_assumption: independent Bernoulli coin or standard PRF security

reset.action_during_reset: exact commit with fast shadow for fresh labels
reset.evidence_split: chronological train/design/later empirical stress screen with no coverage claim; accepted deployment coverage starts from fresh future audit e-values
reset.monotone_safety_guard: new score is max(reset score, immutable launch sentinel score), and the reset threshold may not exceed the launch sentinel threshold
reset.pathwise_reserve: freeze each closed epoch upper bound; carry only beta0 + epsilon*K_prior - U_prior into the new ledger
triggers: optional persistent unsupported support key when that trigger is enabled
local anytime intended-risk upper exceeds epsilon

threshold_policy.fast_candidate: current fingerprint valid, score <= frozen threshold, support key enabled, delay contract valid, no reset active, and the prospective pathwise gate passes
threshold_policy.opportunity_cost: pre-coin predicted fast gain minus predicted audit gain, both including cache shadow value; realized current cost is forbidden
threshold_policy.pathwise_gate: permit the unaudited branch only when its prospective committed-loss upper endpoint is <= carried_reserve + epsilon*(K+1)
